environment: Windows 11 Pro x64, MSVC 19.51, GNS 1.6.1 and OpenSSL 3.6.5 via vcpkg 65a2c23, loopback; real time
game_exe_sha256: N/A (prototype does not touch the game)
objective: Implement ChatGPT review #11 (FB-11-01..05) on feature/review11-gns-readiness: measure, then gate the secure client's DTLS start on the inner GNS Connected; departure edge cases; cookie and coalescing checks; full v6 battery at HEAD with seeded harsh repeats.
hypothesis: KI-38: on GNS the first ClientHellos are sent before the inner connection exists and are lost, inflating KI-35; starting DTLS on inner Connected removes that cost, and the full v6 battery plus seeded repeats pass.
procedure: Added inner_connected/inner_disconnected traces; 4 quick 30 s harsh-gns-secure runs measured the inner connect time against the first ClientHello and the host's receipt. Then implemented the gate, inner-failure reporting, bounded linger, departure tests, coalesce_records option and tests, replayed-cookie test, soak.ps1 -SeedBase. Battery at 4cf1935: all suites x2 on both builds, E2E, asymmetric x4, secure E2E x4, 12 x 120 s v6 soaks, then 4 more seeded repeats each of harsh-gns-secure and harsh-udp-secure, with timelines.
expected_result: Early ClientHellos lost on GNS; after the gate none are sent early; all suites pass; all soaks pass gate v6.
observed_result: Measurement (4 quick runs): the inner GNS connection came up 362-869 ms after the first ClientHello, with 2-3 ClientHellos sent before it; in 3 of 4 runs they were queued by GNS and all reached the host about 100 ms after the connection came up (in the 4th none within 200 ms). So the 'lost' part of KI-38 is contradicted; the cost was the DTLS timer backing off during the GNS connect plus duplicate HelloVerifyRequests. After the gate: 0 ClientHellos before inner Connected in every run; a failed GNS connect is reported as inner_connect_failed after GNS's 10 s initial timeout with 0 DTLS datagrams sent (before: only at the 20 s client deadline). Coalescing comparison: off 10 datagrams in 2 retransmission rounds, on 2. Replayed cookie from another address: 5 HelloVerifyRequests, 0 pending sessions. Suites x2 on both builds all passed: dtls 56, integration 50, integration-gns 35 + 15 skipped, network 17, network-gns 12 + 5 skipped, transport 18, transport-both 20, unit 17, gns 7. E2E, asymmetric 4/4, secure E2E 4/4 passed. v6 battery at HEAD: 12/12 passed (harsh-gns-secure 1572 ms). Seeded repeats: harsh-gns-secure 3056 (FAILED), 2900, 1808, 5217 (FAILED) ms, i.e. 2/5 fail including the battery run; harsh-udp-secure 2339, 2094, 1942, 3274 (FAILED) ms, i.e. 1/5 fail. Timelines: on GNS the host timeout notice takes 174-467 ms and GNS's own connection setup 392-2072 ms before DTLS starts; DTLS 0.6-2.3 s with 0-4 timers; ConnectRequest/Accept 0.2-1.7 s in multiples of the 500 ms retry. hello_rate_limited was 0 in every run. Also found: KI-40, GNS-build test executables hanging at exit after writing results (twice; it stopped the first battery attempt, which was restarted with failure-tolerant steps and a hang watcher; 0 hangs in the clean battery); one soak (180016) stopped after its warm-up and is kept without summary.
errors: KI-35 not resolved: 3 of 10 seeded harsh secure runs failed the 3 s recovery gate; KI-40 open; one soak aborted by the harness (kept).
follow_up: KI-35: decide, with measured justification, between a shorter reconnect retry, a cookie bypass where the inner transport proves return routability (needs GNS source verification), and overlapping the session handshake with authentication; KI-40 exit hang; KI-28b; LAN test; external review.
